text:
hannah (ae): FYI Prospect Meridian wants POC next week but procurement insists on notarized MSA + PO before any data moves. Any quick options?
paul (sales-eng): POC price is signed off. Main blockers: notarization requirement and HSM attestation ask. We can provide an infra attestation letter for POC.
rebecca (legal): We should not set a broad notarization precedent. Offer two paths: (A) e-notary via DocuSign/eID or (B) physical notarization with scanned certificate up-front and originals mailed within 30 days. Limit notary to the customer exec only.
rebecca (legal): Also push back on their indemnity and per-subprocessor prior-consent request. Counter with our standard mutual indemnity for gross negligence/willful misconduct and LCap = greater of $1M or prior 12 months' fees.
omar (finance): Default billing net30. If they require net45 for POC we need PO + AR approval before provisioning. If they can send PO with net30 referencing Order Form, we can provision after execution.
hannah (ae): Can legal draft a one-paragraph POC addendum tying provisioning to either e-notary OR scanned notary + PO? That keeps timeline visible.
paul (sales-eng): I'll ask procurement whether scanned certificate + originals within 30 days is acceptable and confirm signer name. Also offer attestation letter for HSM.
rebecca (legal): Draft addendum suggestion: "Vendor will provision POC upon execution of the Order Form and either (a) an electronically notarized signature using an industry-standard e-notary service or (b) a scanned notarization certificate evidencing a physically notarized signature of Customer's authorized executive, provided Customer delivers the original notarization certificate to Vendor within thirty (30) days. Provisioning is also contingent on receipt of a Purchase Order referencing the Order Form."
esign-bot: :page_facing_up: Envelope 9f2a created (MSA_meridian_v2_redline.pdf, OrderForm_POC.pdf). Status: awaiting customer signature.
hannah (ae): I'll send tracked changes + the addendum and request PO in parallel.
paul (sales-eng): Counsel prefers physical notary but said they can scan first. I'll DM to confirm.
rebecca (legal): OK to accept scanned notary initially with originals within 30 days; will add language limiting this compromise to the POC Order Form only.
omar (finance): If PO arrives with net30 referenced to the orderform we'll greenlight provisioning immediately after MSA executes. If net45, provisioning paused until AR signs off.
hannah (ae): Closing thread for now  will update when PO or signed docs arrive. :thumbsup:
